title: Vivid Intrusion
description:
Vivid Intrusion is a fast paced FPS roguelike with an emphasis on movement. Each run takes ~20 minutes. No wasting time on looting and exploration, instead get right into the action! Soak in the crystalline essence of those who oppose you and grow stronger. Want more weapons? Want more infusions? Complete the challenges of the cube and you will be rewarded.

ARE YOU WORTHY?Choose from a variety of weapons. Destroy waves of enemies and bosses. Can you survive through the various challenges thrown at you?

• 5 boss fights. Replay the game to experience them all

• 10 unique enemies. No wave will feel the same

• 6 arenas with distinct environmental effects to put you out of your comfort zone

MOVE OR DIEDash, jump, and slide around the arena using the extensive movement system.

THE FOG CONSUMESThe arena is constricted by an ever-shrinking wall of fog. Kill, or be suffocated.

PROVE YOUR WORTHClaim the essence of your slain foes and infuse the your run with unique modifiers. With 40+ infusions, every run is different.
description_short: A fast paced FPS roguelike with an emphasis on movement. Imbue your weapon with unique effects that make each run different. Survive a variety of arenas, enemies, and boss fights. Are you able to stay ahead of the curve and complete all your trials?
